set.body:
Outcome

Delete generic Searchlight and CenteredSearchlight storage from locus-data and migrate consumers to compact locus4s NeighborhoodSystem values.

Work

- Convert image, surface, and MVPA consumers to the compact center domain plus ambient embedding.
- Preserve center order and convert regional centers through Selection embedding.
- Use CenteredNeighborhoodSystem where self-membership is a required proof.
- Keep volume radius, mask, support, and provenance policy in scalafim-image.
- Keep surface geodesic construction and neuroimaging policy in scalafim-surface or its future mesh integration.
- Allow richer scientific result records only when they add construction policy or provenance beyond the locus4s value.

Acceptance

- No ambient-domain relation with forced empty non-center rows remains.
- Neighborhood membership, center embedding, sparse-center behavior, and centered reflexivity match the previous public behavior.
- Image and surface constructors return authoritative locus4s structures without moving geometry algorithms upstream.
- Focused JVM and Scala.js suites cover all-center, sparse-center, empty, singleton, owner mismatch, and stable center-order cases.
set.title: Replace structural Searchlight types with locus4s NeighborhoodSystem
